text:
Outlaw torment, enter, leave
+through one same quadrangular hole.
+Doubt. The balance stabs and stabs
+up to the hilt.
+
+At times I strike against all counterstrikes,
+and for a while I am the blackest high of the apices
+in Harmony’s fatality.
+Then the dark circles under the eyes flare divinely,
+and the saw of the soul sobs,
+oxygens of goodwill turn violent,
+all that does not burn burns, and even
+pain crooks its beak into laughter.
+
+But one day you will not be able to enter
+or leave, with the fistful of earth
+I shall throw into your eyes, outlaw!

translation.title: Trilce: Poem LIV — Outlaw Torment, Enter, Leave
translation.editorial_note: The repeated contras become counterstrikes, carrying opposition and collision; sierra remains a saw so its sob can cut through the physiological and musical field.
